title: Ground-fixed sign compatibility
packet_profile: each of 8 packets has 12 plus and 12 minus rows
interpretation: The fixed-ground stabilized carrier action preserves packetwise balanced sign profiles. The ground packet stays fixed with its 12 plus / 12 minus profile, and the eight-packet carrier has global profile 96 plus / 96 minus.
honesty_boundary: This tests sign-profile compatibility, not a microscopic flag-by-flag D4 action inside each 24-flag packet.
